title: Starship
contentHtml:
My favorite commentary on SpaceX’s historic catching of Starship was this:

…we may be certain of this: for all but a vanishingly brief instant near the dawn of history, the word ‘ship’ will mean ‘spaceship.’

Arthur C. Clarke (1965).

Yesterday, this became vividly real to me.

Hat tip: @amdreaesposito

Addendum: Good post on why catching Starship was a super leap over catching Superheavy.
